claim: The supplied laser safety glasses must be worn during laser operation. One set ships with the system; everyone present where stray laser light could be must wear a pair, and providing the extra sets is the operator's responsibility.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 9 (PDF page 11). Also Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 22 (PDF page 26). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
